title: Generate catalogue listings from the open-calls records
design: A listing per opportunity, extracted from its record, published to a storefront.
hypothesis: A catalogue can be generated from these records today without publishing a claim that cannot be traced.

assumptions.statement: Every published field extracts from a named record or is emitted blank.
The cost of a blank field stays bounded to one conversation.
Enough records carry sourced obligations for a listing to be worth publishing at all.
assumptions.note: 6 of 16. This is the assumption the whole proposal turns on and it is the weakest.
